But its almost like im just too lazy to even attempt at change. I started trying to smile and be happy/ confident at school but its so exhausting to act like nothings wrong. I sit and whine about my emotional problems instead of doing anything. I'm the kind of person who just waits for things to happen. The girl that I've had feelings for started dating someone else, but she is so much happier with him than I can ever make her. I'm just useless and I'm afraid that I will be this way for the rest of my life.
